motivation: V2 selects species-wide forcing for all three species. The ecological site-trait effect must therefore remain protected from broad spatial composition differences that were previously absorbed by regional forcing groups.
loading_model: lambda_i = 1 + alpha_block[i] + gamma_A A_within_block + gamma_H H_within_block + gamma_AH AH_within_block + b_i
identification: one species-wide forcing has mean zero over annual transitions
A, H and A:H are centered within the frozen trait-adjustment block
residual b has mean zero within each trait-adjustment block
block intercepts have site-count-weighted mean zero, implying species-wide mean lambda = 1
singleton_rule: A singleton adjustment block has centered trait values exactly zero and therefore contributes to the block intercept but not to the site-trait slopes.

simulation.truths: exactly inherit V2: null, crossover gamma_AH=-0.35, simple buffering gamma_A=-0.25

unlock: Real outcomes remain locked unless spatially adjusted V3 passes the same recovery thresholds for all three species and observation-source sensitivity recovery also passes for all outcome-blind testable species.
boundary: No real count magnitude is read or modeled.
Forcing remains species-wide; regional blocks are adjustment strata only and are not separate latent forcing factors.
No block is selected from outcomes. The fields are the previously frozen geography used in Gate 2C/2D.
No site is deleted because its block is a singleton.
